 bet365 Carabao Cup preview
 The Carabao Cup returns this week, with fixtures like Man City vs Brighton and Bournemouth vs Aston Villa, while our preview focuses on Chelsea vs Liverpool.
 Liverpool vs Chelsea preview (Wednesday 8pm)
 The last 16 of the Carabao Cup has delivered a mouth-watering tie, with Liverpool taking on Chelsea at Anfield. Both clubs have started the season well under new managers, but Andoni Iraola will be the happier of the pair, following Liverpool’s 2-0 victory over Brighton on the weekend. Xabi Alonso’s Chelsea side lost 2-0 to Spurs at Stamford Bridge, with Cole Palmer getting sent off late in the match.
 While the main aim for both clubs this season will be to qualify for the Champions League, there is nothing better for new managers than to win a trophy in their first campaign. The Carabao Cup gives them the perfect opportunity to do this, and if they can knock out one of their rivals before the last eight, then it gives them an even bigger chance.
 The likes of Alexander Isak and Joao Pedro have been in good form this season, but Pedro was injured on the weekend, so he remains a doubt for this game, giving Iraola another boost ahead of Wednesday night. You have to head back to 2023 for the last goalless draw between the two clubs, so we are expecting goals in an exciting Anfield atmosphere this week.
